data_fields.name: initial_aggro_bonus
data_fields.donor_constant: 100 hate added to a new entry

best_idea: Keep a per-creature hate table that accumulates each hit, re-picks the target on a short timer with percent bonuses for melee range, near-death and sitting targets, and drops entries that go stale or stray out of leash, which is the engine shape for many-on-one with MAX_ATTACKERS = 3.
decision_why: Take the hate table, the damage-credit cap at HP left, the melee-range and near-death bonuses, and the two-pass leash and stale cleanup; drop sitting and tunnel vision, which Frankendom does not need.
acceptance: A 3-on-1 zone server test: a creature in melee range with equal hate beats one out of melee range on the next re-pick, a near-death creature in melee range takes the target on the next re-pick, a creature more than two cleanup passes outside the leash is removed, and the same seed gives the same target sequence on replay.
